item.tib: stag la me 'bar bdag rdzogs gsang ba mchog gis sgrub pa la mtha' sgyur las kyi man ngag gnad kyi thim yig
item.coloph: bsrung bzlog (srung zlog) bsad pa'i man ngag gnad kyi thim yig zhes bya 'di/ skyabs gnas rin po che bde chen mi 'gyur snying po'i zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa'i/ rang phrug ye shes snying po bdag gis chu 'brug gis (gi) lo yi/ tshes grang (grangs) bzang por bkra shis ri khrod du bgyis pa 'di yi sems can la phan pa dang / bstan pa'i rgyan chen por gyur nas/ rnam mkhyen gong 'phang myur du thob pa'i don 'grub par gyur cig
